source_project: GeoBenchX tools ported in GeoNatureAgent Benchmark
method_family: metric buffering and topological predicate selection
task: Create a 50 km buffer around the province of Murcia and list all Spanish provinces whose geometry intersects that buffer. Save the buffer and selected provinces.
notes: Use a projected CRS with metre units before buffering. Use the intersects predicate against the 50 km buffer, not within or contains. Preserve EPSG:4326 in GeoJSON outputs.
